metadata.question: Was the surface water extent along the borders of Craighead and Jackson counties in northeastern Arkansas on April 13, 2025 greater than on April 13, 2023?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use Sentinel-1 SAR data (JRC/GSW is monthly/yearly, not suitable for specific dates) - Location: Border area between Craighead and Jackson counties, Arkansas - Dates: April 13, 2025 and April 13, 2023 - Need exact date matches or closest available dates 2. Masking strategy: - SAR data doesn't need cloud masking - Use VV or VH polarization to detect water (low backscatter = water) - Threshold approach: values below -15 to -20 dB typically indicate water 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - C1: No SAR images found for either date - C2: Images exist but processing yields 0 valid pixels - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN - Valid comparison: Both dates have valid water extent values ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define the border region between Craighead and Jackson counties, Arkansas // Approximate coordinates for the shared border area const geom = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-90.9, 35.7], [-90.9, 35.9], [-90.6, 35.9], [-90.6, 35.7], [-90.9, 35.7]] ]); // Define dates const date2023 = '2023-04-13'; const date2025 = '2025-04-13'; // Function to get water extent for a specific date function getWaterExtent(targetDate) { const col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S1_GRD') .filterBounds(geom) .filterDate(targetDate, ee.Date(targetDate).advance(1, 'day')) .filter(ee.Filter.eq('instrumentMode', 'IW')) .select('VV'); const size = col.size().getInfo(); if (size === 0) { // Try wider date range (±3 days) const colWide = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S1_GRD') .filterBounds(geom) .filterDate(ee.Date(targetDate).advance(-3, 'day'), ee.Date(targetDate).advance(4, 'day')) .filter(ee.Filter.eq('instrumentMode', 'IW')) .select('VV'); return { col: colWide, size: colWide.size().getInfo() }; } return { col: col, size: size }; } // Get collections for both dates const result2023 = getWaterExtent(date2023); const result2025 = getWaterExtent(date2025); console.log(`2023 Images: ${result2023.size}`); console.log(`2025 Images: ${result2025.size}`); if (result2023.size === 0 || result2025.size === 0) { console.log("No Sentinel-1 data for one or both dates."); console.log("C1"); return; } // Process images - detect water using VV < -15 dB threshold const img2023 = result2023.col.mean(); const img2025 = result2025.col.mean(); const water2023 = img2023.lt(-15); const water2025 = img2025.lt(-15); // Calculate water extent (area in square meters) const stats2023 = water2023.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: geom, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const stats2025 = water2025.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: geom, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const waterPixels2023 = stats2023.get('VV').getInfo(); const waterPixels2025 = stats2025.get('VV').getInfo(); console.log(`2023 Water pixels: ${waterPixels2023}`); console.log(`2025 Water pixels: ${waterPixels2025}`); if (waterPixels2023 === null || waterPixels2025 === null) { console.log("Calculation failed."); console.log("C3"); return; } // Calculate actual water area (pixels * scale^2) const area2023 = waterPixels2023 * 9000000; // 3000m * 3000m const area2025 = waterPixels2025 * 9000000; console.log(`2023 Water extent: ${(area2023 / 1e6).toFixed(2)} km2`); console.log(`2025 Water extent: ${(area2025 / 1e6).toFixed(2)} km2`); if (area2025 > area2023) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
